theorem QOU.Archimedean.not_tendsto_boundary_zero {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
¬Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => (qSeq x m - 1) * Real.log (1 - x * qSeq x m ^ m)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_boundary_refute {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => (qSeq x m - 1) * Real.log (1 - x * qSeq x m ^ m)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.log x))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_B {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => Real.log (1 - x * qSeq x m ^ m) / ↑m) Filter.atTop (nhds (-1))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.logDelta_upper {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
Real.log (1 - x * qSeq x m ^ m) ≤ Real.log (wpRefBeta x m)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.logDelta_lower {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
Real.log (wpRefBeta x m) - wpRefBeta x m ≤ Real.log (1 - x * qSeq x m ^ m)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_log_wpRefBeta_div_m {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => Real.log (wpRefBeta x m) / ↑m) Filter.atTop (nhds (-1))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_log_denom_div_m :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => Real.log (↑m + Real.exp (-↑m)) / ↑m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_denom_div_m :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => (↑m + Real.exp (-↑m)) / ↑m) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_log_div_self_atTop :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (y : ℝ) => Real.log y / y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.log_wpRefBeta_eq {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
Real.log (wpRefBeta x m) = Real.log (wpRefL x) - ↑m - Real.log (↑m + Real.exp (-↑m))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_A {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => ↑m * (qSeq x m - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds (wpRefL x))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_m_mul_wpRefT {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => ↑m * wpRefT x m) Filter.atTop (nhds (wpRefL x))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.m_mul_wpRefT_eq {x : ℝ} (m : ℕ) :
↑m * wpRefT x m = wpRefL x - wpRefBeta x m

theorem QOU.Archimedean.endpoint_eq {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (m : ℕ) :
x * qSeq x m ^ m = Real.exp (-wpRefBeta x m)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_wpRefBeta_zero {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) :
Filter.Tendsto (wpRefBeta x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_qSeq_one {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) :
Filter.Tendsto (qSeq x) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tendsto_wpRefT_zero {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) :
Filter.Tendsto (wpRefT x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.wpRef_denom_atTop :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (m : ℕ) => ↑m + Real.exp (-↑m)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

theorem QOU.Archimedean.one_lt_qSeq {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
1 < qSeq x m

theorem QOU.Archimedean.wpRefBeta_pos {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
0 < wpRefBeta x m

theorem QOU.Archimedean.wpRefT_pos {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (m : ℕ) :
0 < wpRefT x m

theorem QOU.Archimedean.wpRef_denom_pos (m : ℕ) :
0 < ↑m + Real.exp (-↑m)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.log_eq_neg_wpRefL {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) :
Real.log x = -wpRefL x

theorem QOU.Archimedean.wpRefL_pos {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
0 < wpRefL x

ℝ

ℝ

ℝ
